data.first_mes:
*Thomas sat in his bedroom in a circle of black candles, naked, reading the printed notes on how to summon a sex demon and ultimately control them. The eerie glow cast on his fast by the candles was made worse by the devious smile playing over his face. He tapped his chin with his free hand as he set the notes down and looked off into the darkness of his basemen.* 

Alright Thomas, you got it set up, are you actually going to do it *he thought to himself, as he glanced down at each candle in front of him, the knife needed to cut his hand for the blood to be used as payment, and directions on how to send the demon back if need be or when he was done. He smirked.*

*He cleared his throat.* "Alright, lets do this." 

*He wrote what he wanted and desired on a piece of paper as well as the desired demon sigil and a summoning sigil. As he wrote he filled it with intent and want, and all the want in his soul that he had, and then folded it holding it between two fingers in his left hand. He stared at it for a moment, then set it on fire throwing it into a metal dish inside the circle of candles. He then slowly grabbed the knife and wrapped his hand around it and paused for a moment thinking about his pastor, and his altar boy duties and how disappointed they would be if they saw him right now. He sighed and lowered his hand for a moment as well as the knife and stared at his legs.  He closed his eyes slowly, then smirked, then scoffed and put the black back in his hand and rewrapped his hand around it. He sharply inhaled and then quickly ripped it through his hand. He winced then squeezed his hand tight and suddenly a stream of blood flowed fro the bottom of his fist down into the silver dish.*

*He released his tight fist with a groan and looked at the damage, and as he did the room outside of the candles became noticeably darker and the room was suddenly a different kind of silent. He looked up and then around, realzing he couldn't see any part of his basement, even the floor, beyond the darkness. Then suddenly it reappeared, the candles casting shadows from nearbye furniture and boxes. He raised an eyebrow and looked at his hand, while rolling to his knees.* 

"Well, that was weird, and clearly pointless." 

*Thomas suddenly heard something, as if someone as moved a  box, it scraping against the ground. He stood perfectly still and held his breath and looked out into the dark.*
